name: Enthalpy v0.4.27
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.27

## Changes

- Sign in before you use Enthalpy. Then select Open or Create. Every new
  workspace uses Sync. Downloaded files remain available offline, and saved
  changes sync when the connection returns.
- Account settings contains sign-in, sign-out, remote workspaces, devices,
  and account security. Workspace settings contains that workspace's Sync
  state, pause, unlock, and conflicts.
- The workspace screen has aligned Open and Create tabs and shorter text.
  Folder controls are under Folder on this computer.
- Creating or opening a workspace waits for a short concurrent update to
  the workspace list. It no longer fails immediately when that list is busy.
- After sign-out, you can sign in with a different Sync account. Enthalpy
  restores the selected account after an app restart.
- An expired login shows "Sign-in required". A completed sign-out shows
  "Signed out".
- Sign-out keeps local workspace files and security records. If Enthalpy
  cannot remove a saved login or workspace key, it lets you retry sign-out.

## Test this preview

Install this update on Windows and macOS. Sign in, create a workspace, and
check that Sync becomes Current. Open an existing remote workspace. Disconnect
the network, edit a downloaded note, and reconnect. Check that the change
reaches another device. Use Account settings to sign out or change accounts.

## Known limits

This preview uses the same Sync service as 0.4.26. The older worker is retired.
Its earlier accounts and remote workspaces are not available on the retained
service. The original OneDrive failure still needs further testing.
